input.quote: ARTICLE XXI EFFECT OF TERMINATION Upon termination of this Agreement: for any reason (a) the rights and licenses granted to Licensee pursuant to this Agreement will automatically terminate, and (b) Licensee shall, within five (5) days, ship to Licensor all Licensed Technology, API's Documentation with respect to the Licensed Technology and other Confidential Information in Licensee's possession or control
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no transition-assistance or data-return provision. Article XXI (Effect of Termination) runs one way only: the licenses terminate and the Licensee must ship all Licensed Technology, documentation and Confidential Information back to Licensor within five days, with officer certification. Nothing anywhere requires Licensor to return or export Licensee's data, trade records or customer information held in the hosted platform, to assist with migration, or to certify deletion; the confidentiality article (p0124) imposes obligations on the Licensee only, and Articles XIX-XXIII are silent on wind-down. On a hosted FX trading platform this leaves our data stranded in Licensor's systems with no export right and no protection against immediate deletion, which is walk-away territory under the rule. We inserted the preferred position as a new Article XXI(c): six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, return of our data in a commonly used machine-readable format within 30 days, and deletion with written certification thereafter, plus a bar on deletion before return is complete. Fallback of 90 days' assistance with a 30-day export remains available if Licensor pushes back on the assistance period.

ops.text: (c) TRANSITION ASSISTANCE AND RETURN OF LICENSEE DATA. Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Licensor shall (i) at Licensee's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for a period of up to six (6) months at Licensor's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days of Licensee's request, return to Licensee all Licensee data, trade records and other information relating to Licensee or its customers that is held in or generated through the Licensed Technology, in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Licensee in writing. Licensor shall not delete or withhold access to such data prior to completing the return described in clause (ii).

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added an orderly exit: Licensor returns our data in a machine-readable format within 30 days, provides up to six months of transition assistance at its then-current rates, and only then deletes and certifies deletion. Article XXI currently only requires us to return Licensor's materials and is silent on our own data, which we cannot accept on a hosted trading platform.
proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance and data-return obligation into Article XXI (Effect of Termination).
